price_policy: Always use official first-party vendor standard USD prices (current or historical official publication when retired on first-party API; never substitute third-party reseller rates for models with official vendor rates). Exclude temporary Gemini promotional discounts in favor of normal standard prices. When cache_write has multiple TTL durations (e.g., 5m vs 1h, 30m vs 12h), select the shorter TTL. Use models.dev or LiteLLM USD reference rates only when the vendor has never published a standard USD pay-as-you-go token price (such as open-weight-only models); null means unknown.
review_changes: 2026-11-27: overhaul catalog for mainstream vendors and latest 2026 flagship releases; remove obscure models (command-a-plus, mimo-v2.6-*, step-*).
2026-11-27: add explicit Gemini thinking-intensity aliases (including image thinking models) and apply normal non-promotional Gemini prices.
2026-11-27: select shorter cache_write TTL where tiered by duration (Anthropic 5m, Kimi 5m, OpenAI 30m).

2026-11-27: enforce strict first-party official pricing across current and retired vendor models (including DeepSeek V4.1/V4-0731/V4-Pro/V3.2/V3.1/V3/R1, OpenAI May-2024 GPT-4o & Codex/o-series, xAI Grok 4.1 Fast & 3 Mini Fast, Alibaba International Qwen3.8-27B & 2.4T, Moonshot Kimi K2/Thinking, MiniMax M2.x, Tencent Hunyuan Hy4, Microsoft MAI-Code); separate distinct SKUs with different prices or model identities.
